title: Future Self Alignment
equation: Alignment = Actions Serving Future Self ÷ Total Actions Today
hook: Most of my day was spent keeping present me comfortable. Future me was getting nothing.
statement: Design your days for the person you want to become, not just for how you feel today.
explainer: Five years from now gets built out of what you do today. If most of your actions serve comfort, that's the future you're building.
sop: Write a short, specific description of who you want to be in 5 years.
List today's key actions. Mark each as future self or just comfort.
Divide Actions Serving Future Self by Total Actions Today.
Swap one comfort action this week for one that builds the future.
Update the description each quarter as you change.
equation_example: 4 Actions Serving Future Self out of 10 Total Actions Today. 4 ÷ 10 = 40%. Higher means today is building who you want to be. Lower means today mostly serves short-term comfort.
question: Write down one thing you did today that your five-years-from-now self would thank you for.
closing_statement: Today either builds your future self or delays them.
caption:
Principle Nº 162: Future Self Alignment

Most of my day was spent keeping present me comfortable. Future me was getting nothing.

Design your days for the person you want to become, not just for how you feel today.

Your turn: Write down one thing you did today that your five-years-from-now self would thank you for.
